_comment: Example function/tool registration for OpenAI Codex / Agents SDK. Register SELFPROMPT_TOOL_SCHEMA (see selfprompt.connectors.codex) and route calls through handle_tool_call().

function.name: selfprompt_run_goal
function.description: Pursue a goal autonomously via a bounded self-prompting loop with persistent memory, instead of manually chaining prompts. Use for multi-step tasks with a clear definition of done.
